+# ssg
+
+A small TypeScript static site generator backed entirely by Markdown files.
+
+## Usage
+
+```sh
+npm install
+npm run build
+npx ssg build
+npx ssg build --content ./posts --output ./public
+```
+
+Markdown files may include `title`, `date`, and `tags` frontmatter:
+
+```markdown
+---
+title: Example page
+date: 2024-05-01
+tags: [example, news]
+---
+
+# Page content
+```
